mine_p15_001.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_001.text: On Day 591, Chen Ai asked Lin how the wrist had changed overnight before touching the method report. Lin described what she had actually felt and the movements the previous plan permitted. The pain had not vanished, and one fine touch comparison still differed from her baseline. Sleep and food were real care, not evidence that the route had become usable again. Chen examined the actual tissue and movement within her qualification. Wei's failed control record remained a separate source, with the two eighth unit inputs and grounded release accurately bounded.

mine_cash_care_591.speaker: narrator
mine_cash_care_591.text: The second eight copper clinical appointment was performed and paid from Lin's received common wages. Forty four had remained after Day 590 board and assessment; the actual Day 591 fee left thirty six. No company accident payment or worker workshop deposit entered that purse. Lin counted the coins before the clinic attendant closed the receipt. She had feared the cost and found the arithmetic less frightening when attached to actual services. The money bought qualified reassessment of a changed body. It did not buy a promise that the new local stage would arrive after the appointment.

mine_p15_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_003.text: Chen retained the stopped input plan and adjusted the ordinary movement advice to the observed condition. There was no current evidence allowing the former primary tasks to be treated as reliable usable throughput. The last earned six pair qualification remained history, while current application stayed unavailable pending real recovery and method assessment. Chen could describe tissue condition and duty suitability; Wei would assess taught route control when ordinary care allowed it. Lin disliked waiting for two kinds of evidence. She had seen what happened when a beautiful combined answer made one person appear qualified to decide everything.

mine_p15_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_004.text: The next planned eight copper assessment would be on Day 601, with earlier contact for the ordinary changes Chen had specified. The interval allowed outpatient rest and appropriate ordinary movement at the paid lodging, rather than another invented inpatient discharge. Lin could report new changes without deciding their cause herself. She read the date twice and asked whether useful work could be considered then. Chen said it would depend on the actual duty examination. The calendar supplied an appointment, not a finding. Lin kept the distinction even though she badly wanted the date to be a promise.

mine_p15_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_005.text: Outside the clinic she met Deng Huan, who had come for his own shoulder followup. He chose to share that practical fact and asked whether Lin wanted company on the sound path. Their injuries and methods were different. Deng did not offer his own duty limit as a prescription for her wrist. They talked about the ordinary difficulty of telling coworkers a task remained excluded after pain began to improve. Lin had not reached that improvement yet. She was glad to hear a living account of uncertainty that did not end with every hand becoming whole.

mine_p15_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_006.text: Deng stopped at the roster office to deliver the practical note he had authorized. Lin continued to Han's room without reading it. The separation reminded her that friendship could be close without collecting every private file. At the doorway Lei was ready for the final two hour seated sorting turn from his four week transition. His clinician's actual duty advice still governed it. Lin wished him useful work without asking him to carry her recovery alongside the lamps. He left with the stable fixture arrangement and another worker assigned to excluded carrying, not with newly restored fingers.

mine_p15_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_007.text: Later that day Lei completed the actual Day 591 two hour turn and received its two coppers. The four turns on Days 570, 577, 584, and 591 had now earned the defined eight wages, and the two limited duty checks had actually been performed. Setup and board had their separate paid lines. Ordinary board through Day 597 remained included in the finite forty copper transition response. The current task ended there instead of silently becoming a permanent promise. Lei would need a fresh suitable employment and support arrangement before the next period, just as the mine needed actual current advice.

mine_p15_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_008.text: At supper Lei put the two earned coppers beside his receipt and asked what the second appointment had said. Lin shared the continued input stop and next assessment date. He did not press for private touch findings. His own future was being arranged, and he knew how exhausting it was to have every conversation ask a body to explain itself. They discussed Han's beans instead. Han defended them more passionately than anyone had defended the lamp roster. Lin laughed and discovered laughter did not make the clinical record less serious. Their paid weekly board covered the ordinary meal.

mine_p15_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_009.text: Mu brought a clean cloth from her household supply and offered the laundry transfer she had promised. Lin accepted within the movement advice. Mu handled wet weight; Lin directed where dry things belonged without testing the wrist. The favor took half an hour of Mu's free interval. She left afterward to eat, taking no unspoken night watch. Lin thanked her for performed help rather than imagined limitless devotion. Naming its end let them remain friends without a silent account of resentment. Another chore would need another actual arrangement.

mine_p15_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_010.text: The first stopped week passed slowly. Lin could read authorized references when attention allowed and do ordinary permitted movements, but she sent no input into a route whose current use remained unavailable. A diagram looked ready to accept her. That appearance was not evidence about her changed body. She closed the book whenever the temptation became a proposed test. Han had become good at noticing the pause before she reached for it and asking whether she needed a cup instead. The question was practical company, not a diagnosis disguised as kitchen wisdom.

mine_p15_011.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_011.text: On Day 593 Qiao sent the outside roster through the lodging contact. It named who held the assistant work while Lin's accepted previous block was over and new suitable duties awaited advice. Lin felt displaced when she recognized another person's name beside the receiving board. The person was paid for real hours, not stealing a position that could remain empty indefinitely. She could ask about future work without requiring the mine to mislabel her absence. Qiao included the Day 601 contact for reconsidering a reduced task if qualified findings allowed it. No wage was entered before such a task existed.

mine_p15_012.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_012.text: The assistant came by with a permitted source question after work and asked whether this was a good time. Lin chose to answer the reference while seated, then ended the conversation when he began treating it as another hour of training. He apologized and took the remaining questions to his named lead. Lin had given a useful piece of ordinary knowledge without performing an unrecorded shift. The boundary felt awkward and necessary. She wanted to remain part of work enough that she could easily have accepted a responsibility her current body and paid terms did not support.

mine_p15_013.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_013.text: Cai Ren stopped beside Han's door on his way to an ordinary cart hire. The earlier ankle injury had received its actual qualified care and permitted duty advice, and he had returned to suitable work gradually. His missed outside hire after the old stone still remained missed. He did not offer his improved walk as proof that Lin's route would recover on the same schedule. He brought a repaired pot lid Han had ordered and accepted its agreed payment. A person could come through injury with some function restored and still retain losses the word recovered did not erase.

mine_p15_014.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_014.text: Lin asked how he had tolerated the slow days. Cai said badly. He had shouted at people who deserved a precise complaint and people who had merely offered bread. The honesty made her feel less obliged to be graceful about every uncertainty. Cai also said he had apologized where appropriate and kept his injury claim factual. Bad temper had not invalidated pain, and pain had not justified every cruel word. Lin thanked him for both parts. He went to the hire he actually held, leaving her with company for the stopped period and no borrowed clinical prediction.

mine_p15_015.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_015.text: A young assistant brought a public notice board to the room and asked Lin to hold its lower edge while he copied a number. She refused the loaded grip Chen's current advice excluded. He offered to let her use the other hand, but the weight would still draw her posture into the affected movement. Lin sent him to the assigned sound work table and named the proper source contact. No qi application made the board suitable. The assistant accepted the answer after one embarrassed pause. She had helped him find a safe task without doing the unsafe portion herself.

mine_p15_016.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_016.text: The refusal left her angry long after the board had gone. It was not heavy enough to look dramatic, and she wanted to dismiss the need for help. Lei said a load did not become permitted because it looked less impressive than a falling canopy. His viable hand had its own current exclusions, and he had made the same mistake in thought. Lin listened without borrowing his clinical plan. They could share frustration while respecting different practical findings. She put the private instruction sheet where the next request could meet the actual limit before pride supplied an answer.

mine_p15_017.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_017.text: When Qiao heard about the board, she corrected the rostered task rather than scolding the assistant for wanting accurate work. Lin's oral knowledge could be used only within a later accepted duty that her clinician actually allowed. A clerk holding a board needed its own sound setup now. The mine would provide one instead of making a lodger its missing fastening. Lin liked the absurd image and recognized the serious point. Someone had to assign ordinary materials and people honestly. Her willingness should not be used to fill every unplanned gap in the work arrangement.

mine_p15_018.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_018.text: The market bell rang while she folded the clean cloth with her permitted hand. She heard ordinary life continuing at a distance and envied it more than she wanted to admit. Han asked whether she wished to sit beneath the awning for a interval. Chen's practical movement advice allowed the ordinary walk if kept within the specified limit, and Lin could stop whenever needed. She accepted without making the outing a route trial. The room key went in the reachable pocket. A walk could be an ordinary part of care, not proof that a cultivation application had quietly returned.

mine_p15_019.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_019.text: At the awning Lian Ke was using the calibrated new gauge for a small ordinary commission. He worked more slowly while learning its settings and told the client the actual interval. Lin watched from the public side without leaning on the hurt wrist. The twelve copper compensation had bought the blank and performed calibration, not the old tool's years of wear. A visible pause did not make the new gauge worthless. It helped him use it correctly. Lin could appreciate the analogy and still remember that a measured metal object did not diagnose a living route.

mine_p15_020.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_020.text: A trader tried to sell her a wing fragment for recovery. He called the seam alive and said mineral moth rhythm could persuade a blocked human passage to remember its shape. Lin asked for the qualified human method source. He offered market stories and a price. Jia's permitted observations had supported no such treatment. Lin declined the purchase and returned to the sound ordinary path. She did not need to inspect every fragment to know the claim lacked the required human evidence. The trader looked annoyed that she had asked a question his phrase could not answer.

mine_p15_021.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_021.text: The refusal felt less triumphant than it might have before she was hurt. A part of Lin wanted the trader to have supplied a real source, because a difficult week made a shortcut painfully attractive. She wrote that wish as a wish when she returned to the lodging. She did not grant herself an unidentified medicine or secretly try the fragment so later recovery could be credited to it. Her plan remained qualified ordinary care, stopped input, appropriate movement, food, sleep, and future method checks. Hope could survive inside that slower account without purchasing an unverified cause.

mine_p15_022.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_022.text: At the courtyard contact Guan acknowledged Lin's continued stopped period without opening a practice bench for her. The two unused teaching visits stayed unused under the rescheduling terms. Three qualifying site appointments remained for later actual criteria, and finite consumables stayed under matched condition and custody checks. Lin had spent a used lesson and received an actual failure record. She had not spent every future opportunity. Guan asked whether she wanted her authorized reference copy repaired where its edge had frayed. She accepted that ordinary office task instead of asking him to turn an administrative visit into another input attempt.

mine_p15_023.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_023.text: The separate worker reading workshop envelope still held twelve coppers: Mu, Ou, and Ma's four each for an undelivered service. None paid Lin's clinic. Guan offered a fixed Day 671 latest service date under the amended terms, with actual refund if the promised qualified session could not be provided. Each participant consented separately through the proper contact rather than Lin deciding for them. Mu said she wanted the expiry recorded because waiting without an end made four coppers feel less like a reservation and more like a favor she could not afford to withdraw.

mine_p15_024.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_024.text: Ma approved the limited expiry and asked that a refund never depend on workers agreeing to publish a private technique. Ou agreed, wanting a real explanation of ordinary task limits if the qualified session actually became available. Guan kept those conditions with the existing deposits. The proposed workshop and Lin's personal course remained different purchases by different people. Lin heard the permitted arrangement at the public contact, not their household budgets. The twelve would stay held for the undelivered service until its actual disposition. Caring about her recovery did not give the school a new use for someone else's money.

mine_p15_025.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_025.text: On Day 595 Chen's contact asked for a update if the ordinary warning signs had changed. Lin reported the actual pattern through the authorized clinic message instead of describing every anxious thought as a new tissue finding. No additional paid appointment was performed that day; the bounded message arrangement belonged to the existing outpatient plan. Chen confirmed continued ordinary instructions and the Day 601 assessment unless a specified change required earlier care. Lin kept the acknowledgement. A useful contact could be finite and real without becoming a free daily examination or an excuse to ignore a change that needed one.

mine_p15_026.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_026.text: Wei's reply concerned only the practical clinical limit Lin authorized for method scheduling. The independent examiner kept current input stopped and made no new usable quantity claim. The external field comb's ordinary baseline remained irrelevant to whether the changed wrist and control could now support a taught application. Lin no longer imagined its remembered clean response could overturn Chen's actual findings. The stopped period was not empty method history. It would enter later preparation as time with actual pain, rest, and ordinary movement rather than a blank someone could skip to make progression look inevitable.

mine_p15_027.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_027.text: Lei asked whether Lin wanted to hear about his final sorting turn. One housing had looked sound until light revealed a hairline crack at its fastening. He had set it apart and asked the assigned carrier to follow the damaged item instruction. The story concerned a task within his viable hand's limits. Lin liked hearing a friend be useful without turning it into an argument that she ought to do more while hurt. He had earned two coppers and kept one damaged unit out of the sound count.

mine_p15_028.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_028.text: Han then asked both injured lodgers to stop discussing lamps long enough to eat. The meal had grown cold while they compared the work reference. Lei teased him about running a kitchen with better stop cues than a practice court. Lin smiled and put the page away. The joke belonged to two people who knew their actual limits, not a claim that household care replaced qualified examination. Han's ordinary stew and paid beds supported the stopped week. Neither would tell Wei a bridge had closed or Chen that altered touch had resolved before the actual people assessed it.

mine_cash_board_597.speaker: narrator
mine_cash_board_597.text: On Day 597 Lin paid the next four copper room and meal charge from her received reserve. The thirty six left after the Day 591 assessment became thirty two. This payment covered Days 597 through 603, including the first three days of any suitable reduced work that might later be accepted. She did not charge those same nights again to a proposed five week work block. The next fee would be due on Day 604. Lin marked the actual interval beside the receipt, knowing a continuous bed could otherwise look like several overlapping promises when work and care dates changed.

mine_p15_030.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_030.text: Lei's four week transition board ended on Day 597 after its actual room and meals. Its eight sorting wages, eight limited duty checks, four initial board, four fixture setup, and sixteen later board totaled the forty company coppers assigned. Nothing was owed back because he had accepted ordinary suitable work honestly, and nothing in that closed account promised every future week. Qiao came to discuss a fresh finite agreement. Lei asked the practical movement condition before the wage. Lin listened from the meal table only to the terms they chose to make public, without acquiring his private clinical record.

mine_p15_031.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_031.text: The new arrangement covered eight weeks, Days 598 through 653, subject to the actual qualified duty review on Day 602. It offered one four hour seated sorting half day each week, with agreed rest inside the paid interval, at four coppers when performed. The first turn would be Day 604 if the review allowed it. No active carrying or excluded repair was hidden in the word sorting. Lei could decline or renegotiate before accepting. He chose the defined proposal, retaining the actual movement limit and the knowledge that no wage existed until a suitable turn was actually done.

mine_p15_032.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_032.text: Qiao assigned a separate seventy two copper employer support account: thirty two for eight performed four copper half days, thirty two for eight weekly room and meal payments, and eight for two limited ordinary duty reviews on Days 602 and 630 at four each. The board dates and actual receipt condition were stated. This was a new finite arrangement, not another withdrawal from the already closed forty. Lei's wages would be his own, while board was paid directly under the accepted support terms. Lin's personal clinical fees, private course, and common reserve remained outside it.

mine_p15_033.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_033.text: The clerk accepted the first weekly board payment on Day 598, covering Days 598 through 604. The thirty two wage portion stayed reserved until work was performed. The Day 602 duty review would decide suitability before any turn began. Lei looked relieved and worried. Eight weeks gave him room for useful work while the viable hand retained limits. He promised no miraculous grip to keep the offer. Qiao left the conditions visible rather than asking him to sign beneath an impossible future. The next clinic contact had a real date.

mine_p15_034.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_034.text: After the meeting Lei asked Lin if the support arrangement looked unfair beside her private course injury. She said the canopy had hurt him during assigned work, while her bridge lesson was a personal study task. The different responsibility did not make either person more deserving of care. She had paid for actual assessments from wages saved and had a bed already funded through Day 603. Lei did not owe her money merely because the employer owed a response to his injury. Saying that plainly relieved a discomfort that had begun to turn friendship into a comparison neither person wanted.

mine_p15_035.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_035.text: Qiao asked about the Day 601 appointment without requesting private findings. If actual duty advice allowed it, the mine could offer five suitable four hour half days, on Days 607, 614, 621, 628, and 635, at four coppers each. The task would be seated oral receiving, with a rostered paid clerk handling writing and carriers handling loads. Han's board remained four weekly. Lin could see the possibility without counting twenty wages today. The clinician had not yet examined suitability, no task had been accepted, and no shift had been performed.

mine_p15_036.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_036.text: Qiao explained the proposed oral receiving task with Ren at the public table. Lin would sit with the wrist resting as advised, hear a permitted item reference, compare it aloud with the public disposition, and ask for a source check when it did not match. A rostered paid clerk would write the actual line and handle pages. Assigned carriers would handle loads. The work required attention and voice, not a loaded grip or a concealed cultivation task. It would start only after qualified duty acceptance. Lin could now imagine the limited half day without imagining the old assistant duties restored.

mine_p15_037.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_037.text: Ren wanted the oral check placed inside a receiving interval so he could assign the writer's paid hours honestly. The clerk could not simultaneously keep another yard's count or be treated as free help provided by sympathy. Qiao revised the ordinary staff roster for the same four hours. Lin's proposed four copper wage would pay her actual part, while the other employees remained paid under their own tasks. The arrangement was more complicated than asking her to come back when she felt better. It was also something a hurt person could accept without pretending to carry the missing work invisibly.

mine_p15_038.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_038.text: Lin asked who would sign the reference if she only spoke the comparison. Ren said the record would name the actual writer and Lin's oral check, leaving source decisions with the proper lead. It would not require a painful signature simply to make her contribution look familiar. Lin had not thought that small physical act mattered until the clinic had excluded the grip she normally used. Qiao said accountability could remain specific without turning a particular hand movement into the only proof of labor. The adapted task would have a sound trace because its people and roles were actually named.

mine_p15_039.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_039.text: The proposed first half day was Day 607, after the Day 601 qualified assessment and actual employer acceptance. Later turns would be Days 614, 621, 628, and 635. The four copper board fees fell earlier in each relevant interval, on Days 604, 611, 618, 625, and 632. Lin would use saved money for those payments before counting a wage from work not yet done. Five performed half days could then supply twenty against those twenty later board charges. The first three reduced period nights were already covered by her Day 597 payment. The arithmetic left room to wait honestly.

mine_p15_040.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_040.text: Lin copied no acceptance signature onto the proposal that day. Qiao would wait for actual suitable duty advice and a clear agreement. The practical invitation gave hope a specific shape while leaving the body finding open. Han asked whether he should mark the coming weekly board as paid. Lin said no; only the charge through Day 603 had actually been settled. He left the later spaces blank. The honest blank no longer felt like failure. It was the place where a real future payment could arrive without being invented early to make the room feel safer.

mine_p15_041.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_041.text: Mu listened to the oral task and said it sounded useful, then asked whether four hours of concentration was itself suitable. Lin would ask Chen instead of assuming a wrist injury affected only the hand. Pain, sleep, and attention could change an ordinary work interval. Qiao agreed the roster would include the qualified practical conditions and an actual stop contact if they no longer held. A seated task could still be inappropriate on a bad day. Its purpose was not to make rest look productive at any price. Lin appreciated the question enough to add it before the appointment.

mine_p15_042.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_042.text: The possible reduced schedule meant income could match continuing board while the already saved reserve funded qualified care. It was useful and limited. Lin would not accumulate new savings during those five weeks merely by calling rest work, nor would the job provide fuel or a recovered route. She kept the proposal beside the practical appointment sheet, separate from the actual Day 597 paid receipt. The distinction had become familiar enough to feel less punitive. A projected task could help plan a real recovery without becoming cash before the body and employer had agreed it could be done.

mine_p15_043.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_043.text: Mu brought a household story that evening, this time about a customer who wanted a repaired screen moved to a room too narrow for its safe fastening. She had refused the installation beyond her task and suggested the frame worker. The customer called her unhelpful. Lin said she had begun to understand how often being called helpful meant accepting a responsibility someone else could not fit into their own plan. Mu laughed, then said refusing still hurt when the customer was poor. They let both facts stand. A limit could be necessary and costly without becoming a moral victory.

mine_p15_044.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_044.text: The practice notebook lay closed beside Lin's bed during the Day 598 evening. She could identify its familiar primary landmarks in ordinary thought and still had no permission or evidence to use input through them. The half unit ceiling was a maximum for qualified tasks, not a recommended amount to spend during every doubtful week. Lin rested rather than testing a smaller fraction secretly. A little unauthorized attempt would still be an attempt, with actual body consequences and no useful supervision. The stopped period had to remain real enough that later recovered evidence could mean something.

mine_p15_045.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_045.text: On Day 599 Lin walked to the sound outside office within her ordinary limit and returned before fatigue made it an endurance test. Ren showed the public disposition of the old loss group, keeping private source pages closed. The eighty copper tasks had been paid, and fragments retained under owner terms. Words and usable tools remained lost. Lin could ask a public question without resuming active inquiry. Her earlier inquiry role would matter to findings she might authorize later. It did not keep every past job open through this stopped period.

mine_p15_046.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_046.text: Diao said one source had declined to give a new statement replacing a lost original. Luo had accepted the refusal. Lin did not know the private content and had no right to request a retelling through sympathy. The inventory would say the authorized source was unavailable rather than filling the line with rumor. She thought of how much she wanted her own failed lesson turned into a cleaner story. The source owner's refusal held a different boundary, yet both required living with incompleteness. Accurate work sometimes ended with a blank that caring people could not ethically or practically force closed.

mine_p15_047.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_047.text: Ou brought the public ventilation reference Han had requested and waited until Lin invited a short conversation. The hum after the failure still troubled him. He had checked actual timing rather than letting memory supply its cause. Lin heard the explanation he was permitted to share and left private work statements elsewhere. Ou asked whether her new route could explain the sound. She said it concerned a taught human method, not authority over every noise in mineral and timber. He looked relieved to keep the subjects separate.

mine_p15_048.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_048.text: They spoke about the difficulty of hearing a familiar voice in an uncertain noise. Ou had wanted Lu Sen's return for a moment because the dead worker had once known exactly which lamp route made him nervous. The wish did not create a living source. Lin said Shen's permitted refrain could preserve a memory while the actual ventilation and structural inquiry did different work. Ou nodded and accepted the smaller kind of comfort. He left the public reference with Han, who put it beside the work notice rather than above the stove as a charm.

mine_p15_049.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_049.text: Lin spent one morning making the room contact list usable with her permitted hand. Han supplied a clean copy at the reachable shelf; Mu read the clinic number aloud while Lin checked it against the accepted instruction. They did not copy private findings onto the public list. The task used ordinary adaptation and a finite offered interval, not input through an unavailable route. Lin felt grateful for a practical success she did not have to exaggerate. If a specified change occurred, the correct message could leave without someone hunting through a private book or guessing which appointment owned the question.

mine_p15_050.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_050.text: At the awning a child asked why she held her wrist differently. Lin said it had been hurt and she was following the clinician's practical advice. The child offered a smooth stone supposed to make hands strong. Lin thanked her for the intended kindness and left the stone with its owner. No qualified human method supported the treatment claim, and the object could remain a valued ordinary stone without becoming medicine. The parent apologized for the question. Lin said an honest small question was easier to bear than adults deciding a body was restored because the covering looked neat.

mine_p15_051.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_051.text: Returning to the lodging, she felt the ordinary walk had used its appropriate interval and stopped before fatigue made the trip a private endurance trial. She asked Han for the agreed practical help rather than lifting the laundry bucket on the way in. The bucket would be handled by the person actually assigned for it. Lin had no new input record to hide and no claim that careful walking measured recovered meridians. It was part of outpatient life. She would report the actual discomfort and rest to Chen, where ordinary observations could help shape the next qualified plan.

mine_p15_052.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_052.text: The secondhand seller had arithmetic exercise sheets beneath the awning. Lin mentioned the public offer when Sai Yun asked about the stall, leaving her to decide whether the pages suited her household and actual money. The earlier reader purchase had already been changed by the real timing of Sai's owed wage. A later offer did not erase that history or make every account end alike. Lin could give useful directions now without claiming to repair a missed date in the past. Sai thanked her for the information and said she would inspect the pages herself.

mine_p15_053.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_053.text: At supper Han asked why Lin described Sai's difficulty mostly through the clerk's correction process. He had heard a woman waiting for her own pay while a promised purchase came due. Lin had focused on how the source reference moved and almost lost the ordinary life it served. She corrected herself, keeping the actual timing clear while listening to the household consequence. The reminder made her blush. Evidence needed precision; ordinary speech needed the person receiving it. Those were compatible demands, and neither required rehearsing every imagined version of the same account at the meal table.

mine_p15_054.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_054.text: The Day 600 light was cold and clear. Lin noticed the wrist could perform one ordinary permitted movement with less discomfort than earlier in the week. She recorded the actual change and did not enlarge it into usable throughput or restored six pair control. Fine touch would still be assessed, and input remained stopped. A modest observation was encouraging because it was narrow enough to trust. She asked Lei whether the new duty review made him nervous. He said yes. They planned where each appointment contact would find them and left the body findings to the actual examinations.

mine_p15_055.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_055.text: Wei's scheduling message confirmed that the recovered candidate assessment service included in the fixed independent examination portion could follow the Day 601 clinical appointment if actual advice allowed the ordinary assessment. It would not include an input trial or a new qualification. The unused teaching dates would remain for later revised preparation. Lin had paid for finite independent work, and the service could record continuing unavailability if that was what the condition showed. She wanted the examiner to see improvement. She also wanted a record that would remain useful if improvement was smaller or slower than she wished.

mine_p15_056.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_056.text: At Han's table she set aside the eight coppers due for the actual Day 601 clinical assessment. Thirty two remained before that future fee, with the room and meals already paid through Day 603. If performed, the appointment would leave twenty four. The possible reduced job still supplied no current income. Lin could arrive at the clinic with the accepted service funded and the private teaching record ready. Her fear no longer had to solve tomorrow's money by inventing a wage today. It could remain fear while actual receipts and reserved coins took care of their own finite part.

mine_p15_057.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_057.text: Mu asked whether she wanted company again for the short ordinary walk. Lin accepted the offered interval only after Mu checked it against a paid screen task. The appointment time and return estimate fit; if the clinic ran late, Lin would use the named room contact instead of demanding Mu abandon the customer. The plan sounded less romantic than constant devotion and made both women less anxious. Lin had learned to accept particular help without acquiring a friend's whole day. The recovery would need many such ordinary agreements, each small enough to be kept when life continued around them.

mine_p15_058.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_058.text: Before Day 601, Lin reviewed the proposed task with the real limits written first: no loaded grip, no writing she had not been cleared to perform, no carrying, no cultivation application, and no unrecorded extra hours. The paid writer and carriers would do their own rostered work. She would contribute the permitted oral check only if actual advice and employer acceptance allowed it. That was useful enough to hope for. The mine did not need her to pretend the former assistant work had returned wholesale, and her body did not owe the roster a finding it had not yet earned.

mine_p15_059.speaker: narrator
mine_p15_059.text: The evening song from the yard reached the room as an identifiable living voice. Lin recognized Shen Tao leading the permitted refrain and heard the wall return its delayed sound.
